text: ❗️Andrei Belousov inspects Sever Group of Forces  ▫️ On 17 March 2026, during a working visit to the zone of the special military operation, the Russian Defence Minister inspected units of the Sever Group of Forces and heard reports on the progress of operations at the command post. The main focus was on the expansion of the security belt on the territory of Sumy and Kharkov regions as well as strengthening the defence of the border regions of the Russian Federation.  💬 Commander of the Sever Group of Forces Colonel General Yevgeny Nikiforov reported to the Defence Minister on the successes of the units since the beginning of the year. As a result of cooperated actions, seven U.S.-made HIMARS and MLRS multiple rocket launchers were detected and destroyed.  📈 The commander also noted the increased effectiveness of the measures against enemy drones. Thanks to improved cohesion and training of FPV-interceptor teams, the effectiveness of long-range unmanned aerial vehicle engagement has been significantly improved.  💥 The Sever Group's Unmanned Systems Forces Commander reported to Andrei Belousov that an increase in the number of modern strike and reconnaissance drones made it possible to improve fire on enemy positions and provide continuous air surveillance in all directions.  ⚙️ He also added that an analysis centre had been set up at the unmanned system command post to assess the effectiveness of drone operators in real time. Maintenance elements equipped with programming equipment and 3D printers are deployed to ensure uninterrupted support of the units with UAVs. Thus, they can quickly prepare for the deployment unmanned aerial vehicles of various types. They are as follows: fixed-wing UAVs, hexacopters, copters, and FPV drones.  🤝At the end of the visit to the command post, Andrei Belousov presented state awards to servicemen of the Sever Group, who had distinguished themselves during combat missions. Those who showed courage, heroism and high professionalism in the special military operation received the Order of Courage and the Order 'For Merit Before Fatherland' with Swords, 1st and 2nd classes.   🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
